title: Bayesian-based pharmacokinetic framework integrated with therapeutic drug monitoring for assessing adherence to antiseizure medications: a clinical trial simulation study
core_idea: Propose a Bayesian pharmacokinetic framework that integrates therapeutic drug monitoring measurements, validated population PK models, individual patient covariates (age, weight, creatinine clearance), dosing history and prior adherence probabilities to compute posterior probabilities of dosing behaviors (e.g., full adherence, omitted or consecutive missed doses) for 14 commonly used antiseizure medications, evaluated through clinical trial simulations and systematic covariate assessment.
tldr: Aims to infer patient-specific antiseizure medication adherence by combining Bayesian PK modeling with TDM, population models, and individual covariates in simulation-based assessments.
